about: The rolling hills (docs/design/hills.md): the Wide World's size (12 x 10 world squares, 6912 x 5760 cells, 108 x 90 chunks) and nothing but grass on gentle rolling hills, wrapping both ways ("wrap": "torus"). No plan, no pinned valley, no sea, water, roads, villages, trees or things: generated "hills" is its land, octaves of value noise ([period in cells, height in land units of 0.125 m]) whose periods divide the map's size so it tiles. Too big to bake whole: "bake": false, played from its rows alone (GeneratedSource). Spawn is 32 cells from the east and south seams, so a short walk crosses both. "off" turns off, for this map only, the view's systems a hills map has nothing for.
name: The Rolling Hills
